findings.finding: Native closure metadata is runtime-closure.files, not packages.
findings.resolution: Verifier accepts the actual files schema and requires exactly eight retrieval/node_modules members, each exact bytes/SHA.

findings.finding: Early lexical metadata differed from the auditor fixed all-word multiset formula.
findings.resolution: Aligned ASCII all-word multiset overlap, descending overlap and declared source-ID ties before freeze; explicit regression fixture passes.

findings.finding: Inference-state receipt must observe actual context rather than only intent.
findings.resolution: Tensor inspection and each model call record observed torch inference/gradient/autocast context.

findings.finding: Attempt counters can be stale if written only after expensive actions.
findings.resolution: Persist attempted counters before checkpoint metadata inspection, model factory, conversion, each forward and native Popen; preserve partial/unknown state.

findings.finding: External cleanup receipt needs raw worker identity binding.
findings.resolution: Raw top-level worker PID/PGID and native PID bind the outer exact plan/raw/terminal receipt.

findings.finding: PID-alive-only admission cannot prove exclusive scoped lease.
findings.resolution: Live admission binds exact research lock path, nonsymlink regular inode/device, owner PID/start ticks, kernel FLOCK and denied nonblocking contender; generic actual-lock and wrong-scope fixtures pass.
